career.title: CAREER
career.vidalink: At Vidalink I was responsible for app maintenance, feature refinement and iOS team lead.
career.madeinweb: At MadeInWeb I contributed to iPhone app development, helping the team create new apps and solutions for clients as well as internal projects.
career.james: During my time at James I helped the team refactor and relift the app to improve delivery visibility and the user experience of cart items.
career.santander: I worked on the chat module for Santander, integrating via Carthage and CocoaPods into Santander Empresas and Santander PF apps.
career.qranio: Worked as an iOS developer, gaining experience with Git, Swift, Auto Layout, unit testing, Realm DB and Fastlane.
